limitations: The head branch is based on 6eb1b2e, so the base variant carries 11 unrelated upstream-main commits between 6eb1b2e and f5109b58. Those touch studio/frontend styling/sidebar/settings files; studio/frontend/src/features/chat/hooks/use-chat-model-runtime.ts is byte-identical between the two, so the measured refusal path is unaffected, but the pair is not a pure one-commit comparison.
CPU-only by design: this proves the frontend state machine and the real llama.cpp load/replace flow, not GPU throughput or accelerator-specific behaviour.

Credential-required / Hub-auth-decline rollback was NOT exercised from the UI. The task's own earlier runtime stage already found the credential gate unreachable for a local GGUF with a placeholder token; this validation did not add a real Hub credential flow, so 'credential state if feasible' is answered as not feasible here.

The cancel probe measured the cancel path only as far as 'load stopped, nothing resident'; it did not drive the head's compensating reload back to the previously resident model, so the specific rollback-to-A assertion remains covered only by the head's own frontend test suite, not by this live pair.

The supplementary probe ran against the same two servers used by the primary pair, so both ran after the primary pair's own load activity; each probe re-derived its starting resident model explicitly and recorded it.
